notes.title: Meow-Jong Solitaire V2.0 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have just released V2.0 of Meow-Jong. What's new? Not a whole lot on the surface. We have, however, done many back-end changes, bug fixes, and general cleanup in preparation for the future.

The most important thing we updated is our pipeline for adding new boards. What does this mean for all of you? Well- simply we can add more tile layouts much more easily now! [b]Expect 80 more layouts very soon![/b]

As always, please let us know via e-mail or community post if you run into issues.

Also, if you like Meow-Jong Solitaire but have not given us a rating yet, please spend a moment to rate this game!

Thanks for playing! Meow! =^.^=
